description: Pinned contract fixtures: slim (abi + creation bytecode) Foundry build artifacts the integration-test harness deploys from. VolumeRegistry is the versioned contract; PostageStamp / PriceOracle / TestToken are vendored test-support contracts.

verified_against.method: per deployment: 'eth_getCode' compares this build's deployedBytecode with the live runtime code, immutable references masked, CBOR metadata suffix compared separately; 'deployment_record' compares this build's creation bytecode byte-for-byte (metadata included) with the initcode of the CREATE transaction in the committed deployment record's Foundry broadcast
